04/08/2002:  Daylight Savings Time Adjustment. 
 
             - Daylight Savings Time Started on Day=97, Time=200. 
 
             - Time of Obs were modified by one hour (forward)  
               from Day=97, Time=200 through Day=97, Time=405. 
 
 
 
 
10/29/2001:  Daylight Savings Time Adjustment. 
 
             - Daylight Savings Time Ended on Day=301, Time=200. 
 
             - Time of Obs were modified by one hour (subtracted) 
               from Day=301, Time=200 through Day=301, Time=605. 
 
 
 
10/30/2000:  Daylight Savings Time Adjustment. 
                 
             - Daylight Savings Time Ended on Day=303, Time=200. 
 
             - Time of Obs were modified by one hour (subtracted) 
               from Day=303, Time=200 through Day=304, Time=1105. 
               Only Observation Times were modified, not times of 
               Maxs and Mins.  Users will need to take that into 
               consideration when using this data. 
 
 
 
07/21/2000:  Station Inspection. 
 
              - Station down since 07/15/2000.  Phone line from road 
                to datalogger was cut.  Notified Amy Irish-Brown.   
               
              - Downloaded data to fill in possible data gaps once 
                line is repaired. 
 
 
 
07/21/2000:  Station Maintenance 
              
             - Comments:          
 
                  Needed to install solar panel and possibly troubleshoot modem  
                  and/or phoneline troubles. 
 
                  Burial-grade phone line that runs from the weather station  
                  site to telephone pole is still above ground.  Although wires  
                  inside the access box near the station were connected, it 
                  didn't look real stable so reconnections were made.  The  
                  phoneline from the access box to the modem was not run  
                  through the hole at the bottom of the enclosure - it was  
                  connected into the enclosure through the door, thus pinching 
                  the cable when the door was closed.  Decided to pull the 
                  phone line with the other cables that come up through the  
                  bottom of the enclosure. 
 
                  Doesn't look like any herbicide has been applied to station  
                  plot.  Soil temps are currently under sod.  Soil moisture  
                  probes are fine as they are in a grassy area. 
 
                  Solar panel was installed and datalogger was checked with the  
                  Dell laptop and all data in the buffer was collected. 
 
                  Data values checked at site looked good with increasing  
                  battery voltage numbers reported. 
 
                  Upon return to MSU, same troubles persist.  The modem picks  
                  up, but that is all.  There is static on the line, but no  
                  modem tones. 
 
                  - jtb 
 
 
             - Solar Panel: New Hardware 
                                 
                            Installed near the top of the mast, bracket 
                            sits a few inches below coupling at the top 
                            of the mast and the top edge of the solar 
                            panel is about level with the bottom of the 
                            coupling.  Solar panel faces south with an 
                            an angle of about 45-degrees. 
 
             - Needs: - Modem troubleshooting. 
                      - Leaf Wetness B 
                      - Enclosure Bracket (bottom of enclosure is 
                        not secured to the tripod).

05/15/2000:  Station Installed.   
 
             - Leaf Wetness A:  Bracket mounted 40" from center of tripod, 
                                39" high (~1-meter).  Mounted on NE leg, 
                                sensor facing north. 
 
             - Soil Temp A:     2-inch under sod, west of south leg, north 
                                of Soil Temp B (straight in from fence post). 
 
             - Soil Temp B:     4-inch under sod, west of south leg, south of 
                                Soil Temp A (straight in from fence post). 
 
             - Soil Moisture A: East of south leg, approx. one foot north 
                                of Soil Moisture B (straight in from post). 
 
             - Soil Moisture B: East of South leg, approx. one foot south 
                                of Soil Moisture A (straight in from post). 
 
             - Air Temp/RH:     HMP45C (requires mawn1b) 
 
             - Wind Vane:       Points to North 
 
             - Anemometer:      Points to South 
 
             - Pyranometer:     Stand mounted to SW.  Bottom of bracket 
                                is 40" above tripod bracket. 
 
             - Phone Line:      blue/white  => tip 
                                blue        => ring 
                                red         => ground 
 
             - Needs:           Solar Panel, Enclosure Bracket
